IGUI_ComfyGrid_OptScaleTip: Size multiplier for the grid UI.
IGUI_ComfyGrid_OptSlotsPerCapacityTip: Grid slots granted per point of container capacity.
IGUI_ComfyGrid_OptInstantTransferTip: Move items instantly instead of taking transfer time.
IGUI_ComfyGrid_OptLootSectionsTip: Loot window: show every container within reach as stacked sections, like the inventory window.
IGUI_ComfyGrid_OptCompactRowsTip: Each board shows its items plus one free row (none once the container is full) instead of its whole capacity.
IGUI_ComfyGrid_IncompatibleTetris: Comfy Grid: Inventory Tetris is enabled. Both mods replace the inventory UI and cannot run together - disable one of them.
